text:
alex: Heads-up: hotfix branch for env-var migration is causing service auth to 401 in prod. We need 2x LGTM before 23:45 PST cutoff so we can roll forward. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pull/8742
jamie: On it, can look in ~10m.
maya: Can you paste repro steps? I want to run a quick smoke.
alex: Repro: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $OLD_TOKEN" https://api.redwood.local/v1/health` -> 401 consistently. Patch changes config loader fallback order and adds unit + integration test. Small diff.

alex: Patch contains this change:
```
- config.get('SESSION_TOKEN_SOURCE')
+ config.get('SESSION_TOKEN_SOURCE', 'env_new', 'env_old')
```
jamie: quick read: code looks good. One nit: change log line to `logger.info('using session token source=%s', src)` instead of f-string for structured logs.
jamie: I can give an approve after that tiny tweak.
maya: I can take second LGTM in ~12m. tagging @zach to run staging smoke when ready.
zach: grabbing a quick staging run now. Will ping results here.
sre-bot: Reminder: release cutoff in 25 minutes (23:45 PST). Ensure 2 approvals before cutoff or rollback to next window.
zach: Staging smoke started: hitting /v1/health with old token -> 401, after patch deployed to staging old token accepted, no regressions on other endpoints. logs: `no auth errors in last 120s`
jamie: Nice. I pushed log fix, rebased, and approved on GitHub. :white_check_mark:
maya: Reviewed, tested staging logs, and ran a couple of prompt-generation flows — looks clean. Approved. :thumbsup:
alex: Awesome, thanks all. I'll merge and kick off a 5% canary, then ramp if metrics stable.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release 2026-03-18T23:50Z -> 5% hosts. Monitoring CPU, error-rate, p99 latency.
sre-bot: Canary health check: no increase in 5xx over baseline in first 3 minutes.
alex: Merged and scheduled canary. Will monitor for 15m then cutover. If anything looks off I'll revert.
jamie: Great work, thanks for moving fast.
maya: Thanks — good catch on the migration order.
